소름 돋는 쾌감을 느껴보세요!

오늘은 내용에 최대한 집중하시라고 
자막 없는 버전으로 준비해 봤습니다.

귀로 듣는 괴담집 어떠신가요?

감사합니다!

Today, I would like to introduce a very scary collection of ghost stories.

'The moment you open the pages, the horror sleeping in everyday life awakens!' I’ve brought you *Darkness Ahead*, the first collection of ultra-short ghost stories by Ichi Sawamura, who is regarded as a leading figure in Japanese horror fiction. Today, I’ve prepared a version without subtitles so you can focus fully on the content.

How about listening to this collection of ghost stories, prepared with Ssam-mu's voice for the first time in a while?
